name: VẠN VẬT — Audio & Sound Design Manifest
designPhilosophy: Expansive, wondrous, natural, and contemplative soundscape honoring the scale of the cosmos and the precision of life science.
agentPolicy: ADAPTIVE ATELIER: These BGM tracks and SFX cues are curated recommendations. The AI Director should actively select and place sounds matching the emotional and analytical context of each scene.

recommendedBgm.title: Impact Moderato
recommendedBgm.bestForContext: Astrophysics, planetary orbits, deep space scale, massive natural events, and fundamental physics laws.

recommendedBgm.title: Daily Beetle
recommendedBgm.bestForContext: Biological ecosystems, microscopic organisms, botany, insect life, and everyday science phenomena.
